web.lang.name: English
web.tagline: Base maps for OpenOrienteering Mapper from LiDAR, regional DTM, OSM and ZABAGED
web.footer.not_survey: working base map, not a survey
web.page.novinky_co_je_noveho: News What's new
web.page.presnejsi_rozpoznani_porostu_z_: More accurate vegetation classification from LiDAR and orthophoto (classes, rough open 403, clearings), so that boundaries need less redrawing
web.page.dalsi_ladeni_kresby_silnic_kriz: Further tuning of roads, junctions and paved areas in forest and MTBO maps based on feedback
web.page.vyberte_uzemi_a_typ_mapy_za: Choose an area and a map type – in a few minutes you can download a ZIP with a map for OpenOrienteering Mapper.
web.page.podkladarna_sama_sklada_podklad: Podkladárna automatically builds base maps for orienteering from ČÚZK LiDAR (DMR 5G, DMP OK), the regional DTM, OSM and ZABAGED. The result is a ZIP with .omap (OpenOrienteering Mapper) and .ocd (OCAD) files georeferenced in S-JTSK. It is a working base map, not a finished map – you will still edit it in Mapper and in the field. Podkladárna is an experiment, so feedback is very welcome.
web.page.jak_podkladarna_funguje_limity_: How Podkladárna works, limits and rules
web.page.navic_i_mtbo_mapa_stejny_vyrez: Also an MTBO map (same area, ~+50 % time)
web.page.kazda_mapa_se_sklada_zvlast_pol: Each map is built separately (~half of the time); both come from the same area.
web.page.nabidka_zavisi_na_meritku: The options depend on the scale.
web.page.dva_protilehle_rohy_nebo_v_deta: Click two opposite corners, or open a finished map and choose Use settings and area. Fine-tune the area by dragging its corners, move it with the cross in the middle. LiDAR and ZABAGED are cached; the merged LAZ of a previous map is reused when you iterate. Czech Republic only. MTBO max 25 km² (e.g. 5 × 5 or 7 × 3.5 km), forest max 15 km² (e.g. 4 × 3.75 km), sprint 1:4000 max 4 km² (e.g. 2 × 2 km).
web.page.pretahnete_pro_zmenu_vysky_mapy: Drag to change the map height
web.page.nakreslete_obdelnik_dvema_klikn: Draw a rectangle with two clicks.
web.page.referencni_sablony_ortofoto_osm: Reference templates (orthophoto, OSM, ZTM, cadastre, hillshade, DSM, regional DTM) are always included as online links: they are switched off in Mapper's template list and are downloaded from ČÚZK / OSM only when you switch them on (internet needed). The ZIP stays small.
web.page.kazdy_podklad_je_ve_dvou_varian: Each layer comes in two variants: maximum zoom (orthophoto up to 12.5 cm/px, coarser for a large area) and medium zoom (4× coarser, loads quickly). Mapper does not zoom templates – it loads them once as an image at a fixed resolution. Online templates are GDAL WMS files (.xml / .vrt) that OpenOrienteering Mapper opens but OCAD does not – in OCAD add the layers as WMS following README_OOM.txt. A vector cadastre and Copernicus Sentinel-2 satellite images (10 m/px, true colour) with the image date in the file name are always included: the latest cloud-free one and older ones roughly every 3 months over the last half year, if cloud-free. They show changes since the orthophoto and LiDAR (clearings, windthrow, new buildings); they are not used for drawing the map.
web.page.podklady_se_pribali_do_zipu_jak: The layers are packed into the ZIP as full-resolution images instead of online links: they work offline in the field and in OCAD, but generation takes longer and the ZIP gets much bigger (orthophoto tens to hundreds of MB).
web.page.upravit_nastaveni_vychozi_hodno: Adjust settings – the defaults are recommended
web.page.v_polovine_ekvidistance_jen_kde: At half the contour interval, only where they show a shape the contours miss.
web.page.stridme_vic_jen_kde_ukazou_tvar: “Sparingly” / “More” only where they show a shape the contours miss (a top between levels, a spur, a gully, a gentle slope). “Everywhere” = the whole half interval as a guide to how the slope behaves – you then erase it while drawing.
web.page.doporuceno_zklidni_zubate_vrste: (recommended) calms jagged contours on flat ground and in built-up areas; on slopes they stay as before.
web.page.skutecne_kupky_zlaby_naspy_a_va: Real knolls, gullies, embankments and earth walls are kept.
web.page.je_puvodni_kresba_vrstevnice_ve: is the original drawing: contours follow every small bump of the laser scan more faithfully, so on flat ground and between houses they tend to be jagged and restless. Choose it if you want to see small irregularities too (e.g. for field checks or comparison with an older map).
web.page.od_jake_vysky_brat_porost_jako: From which height vegetation counts as green. Lower = more green.
web.page.1_hladke_bez_posunu_hranice_vyc: 1 – smooth without moving the boundary – default
web.page.2_zjednodusit_drobne_vybezky_a_: 2 – + simplify small spurs and bays (up to 6 m)
web.page.vyhladi_schodky_po_pixelech_1_m: Smooths the pixel steps (1 m); level 1 keeps the boundary in place.
web.page.stupen_1_posun_nejvys_1_5: Level 1: shift at most 1.5 m, 0.4 m on average, the area does not change. Levels 2 and 3 also fill narrow bays and cut off narrow spurs (outlines of single tree crowns). The area never spills over paths, buildings or water from OSM. Sprint draws vegetation unchanged.
web.page.strmy_schod_skalni_plocha_206_m: Steep step = rock area (206), gentler = earth (104).
web.page.detektor_rozlisi_strmy_schod_sk: The detector tells a steep step (rock areas 206) from a gentler bank (earth 104). The “all as…” option overrides it. Knolls and depressions from the DEM are drawn only in forest maps (not in sprint and MTBO). Stand-alone 201 lines are dropped. Earth banks (104) stay as lines; short / tangled detections are filtered out.
web.page.mene_citlive_jen_vyrazne_srazy_: Less sensitive = only distinct banks, fewer false ones.
web.page.vychozi_mene_citlive_cliff1_2_2: Default “less sensitive” (cliff1=2.2 m). A higher threshold = fewer false earth banks. Rock areas (206) have an even stricter drop (+0.7 m) and a smaller footprint (shrink); tangled 104 and short stubs are filtered when the OOM map is assembled.
web.page.kresba_z_dtm_kde_je_dtm: Draw from DTM where available – sprint, forest and MTBO (default)
web.page.jen_sprint_z_dtm_les_a: Only sprint from DTM, forest and MTBO from OSM + ZABAGED
web.page.dtm_digitalni_technicka_mapa_je: The DTM (Digital Technical Map) is the most accurate source: roads by their real width, complex junctions and car parks as areas.
web.page.kde_dtm_pro_uzemi_neni_kresli: Where there is no DTM for the area, everything is drawn from OSM + ZABAGED; you get the same result with “OSM + ZABAGED only”. The default draws sprint, forest and MTBO from DTM.
web.page.zakladni_ve_sprintu_lavicky_sto: Basic – in sprint benches, tables, signposts, monuments, crosses, statues, memorial trees, playground equipment, shelters, fitness, fireplaces, barriers (default)
web.page.vse_navic_lampy_a_informacni_ta: All – also street lamps and information boards (sprint, forest and MTBO)
web.page.drobne_objekty_z_openstreetmap_: Small objects from OpenStreetMap. By default sprint has them, forest and MTBO do not.
web.page.zakladni_sada_lavicky_a_stoly_5: Basic set: benches and tables (531 ×), signposts (531 ×), playground and fitness equipment, fireplaces and barriers (531 ×), shelters and roofs (522), monuments, wayside shrines, crosses and statues (526), memorial trees (417). Playground equipment comes from OSM and, where OSM has nothing, from the height above ground (DMP OK) and the shadow on the orthophoto; a small playground up to 500 m² gets one cross, larger ones crosses at least 4 mm apart, a playground without a find one cross in its open part, private playgrounds nothing. The All option adds street lamps and information boards (streets often have tens to hundreds per km²). Memorial plaques on walls are not drawn, nor are points inside buildings, and identical symbols closer than 2.5 mm do not overlap. Crosses, monuments and trees from ZABAGED are not drawn next to the same object from OSM. Fences, walls and hedges from OSM are always drawn, as are playgrounds and pedestrian areas (501), water (301), cultivated land (412), wells, springs and marshes.
web.page.doplnit_zpevnene_plochy_v_zasta: Fill in paved areas in built-up areas (estimate, mainly sprint)
web.page.nejvetsi_doplnena_plocha_v_mape: Largest filled area in the map
web.page.omezi_jen_auto_omap_ostatni_vel: Limits only the automatic .omap. Other sizes (and sparse ones) are in the ZIP in osm/ for manual import.
web.page.osm_objekty_ve_vyrezu_budovy_am: OSM objects in the area (buildings, amenities, leisure, buffered paths including the black outline… – also those we do not otherwise draw). The result goes below the roads. Each piece is checked against the orthophoto (green) and the DMP OK height (trees, unmapped buildings); where residential has complete DTM areas, gaps are not drawn (DTM draws the paved ones). Without orthophoto and heights the older rule applies: residential where more than 25 % remains after subtraction is skipped. Pieces above the chosen max. size are dropped too. The ZIP (
web.page.zelen_stromy_a_jinak_neoverene_: (green, trees and otherwise unverified) – including the unused band – for manual import in OOM (symbol 501). Heuristic; can be deleted in OOM. Default: off.
web.page.pro_ocad_v_zipu_georeferencovan: for OCAD) in the ZIP, georeferenced in S-JTSK including declination and grid convergence.
web.page.vegetace_z_hustoty_lidar_odrazu: Vegetation from LiDAR return density (canopy height, not runnability), banks from the DTM, contours by GDAL.
web.page.vyberte_meritko_ukaze_se_kolik_: Choose a scale — you will see how many omaps will be created.
web.page.rastr_mapy_s_georeferenci_vypnu: Map raster with georeference. Off saves time and ZIP size.
web.page.raster_mapy_s_pgw_geotiff_pres: Map raster with PGW (± GeoTIFF) via Mapper CLI @ 300 DPI (web preview 150 DPI), otherwise Pillow fallback.
web.page.znovu_stahnout_a_spocitat_podkl: Download and compute the data again
web.page.pri_stejnem_vyrezu_se_obvykle_z: For the same area the stored data are usually reused. Switch this on only if the result looks like it came from old or damaged data.
web.page.ulozena_jsou_napr_lidar_vyskovy: Stored are e.g. LiDAR, the elevation model, hillshading. If you download everything again from ČÚZK, generation will be much slower. Ordinary setting changes (contour interval, benches…) do not invalidate this cache by themselves.
web.page.soukrome_mapu_uvidite_jen_vy_od: Private – only you will see the map, the link comes by e-mail
web.page.po_dokonceni_prijde_odkaz_e_mai: When finished, a link arrives by e-mail — check your spam folder too. The map will not appear in the public list and you will not see the preview/ZIP here. While it runs you can see the pipeline log as with public jobs. The link is valid for 48 hours. Even the longest maps are usually ready within an hour.
web.page.server_je_sdileny_na_prvni_poku: The server is shared: for a first try a smaller area and one scale are enough.
web.page.vyplni_formular_nove_mapy_nazve: Fills the new map form with this map's name, area and settings
web.page.nacist_zadani_do_nove_mapy: Load settings into a new map
web.page.v_openorienteering_mapperu_otev: In OpenOrienteering Mapper open *-les.omap / *-sprint.omap / *-mtbo.omap (in OCAD the .ocd of the same name).
web.page.mapa_je_georeferencovana_podkla: The map is georeferenced, the background layers are templates.
web.page.prisel_podklad_vhod_podkladarna: Was the base map useful? Podkladárna is free. If you want to support further development, a contribution of any size helps.
web.page.stranku_muzete_zavrit_mapu_najd: You can close the page – the map is in the “My maps” list in this browser.
web.page.podkladarna_je_experiment_proto: Podkladárna is an experiment, so a short comment is welcome (also during generation — by e-mail to the author, not public).
web.page.co_sedi_co_ne_napad_na: What works, what doesn't, ideas for improvement…
